title: Guide learners through KWIC concordance lines of a verb and its synonym set, then compare prosodic behavior across the set

description: A three-phase metacognitive routine — Know, Want to know, Learned — that activates prior knowledge before reading and consolidates it afterward.
title: KWL

description: A graphic organizer that structures a lesson around what students Know (K), Want to know (W), and have Learned (L) about a topic.
title: KWL Chart

description: This strategy integrates the Know–Want–Learn chart into the phases of inquiry-based learning so that questioning is scaffolded throughout the lesson.
title: Embed the KWL strategy across inquiry phases to guide question generation and question-quality monitoring

description: K-W-L asks students three questions: two before reading (What I know; What I want to learn) and one after (What I learned).
title: Use the K-W-L strategy (What I know, What I want to learn, What I learned) to activate prior knowledge before reading
